item.title: SFA Fine Celtic After Auston Trusty Appeal
item.description: The SFA have fined Celtic following the unsuccessful appeal against Auston Trusty’s red card. Celtic challenged the dismissal shown to Auston Trusty during the loss with Hibernian, but the appeal was dismissed at a fast-track tribunal.
